import sys
from pathlib import Path
from forge_factory.assurance.normative import compliance_assertions
docs = ['docs/assurance/OPERATIONS.md','docs/assurance/normative-reconciliation-plan.md','docs/adr/ADR-0010-assurance-profile-vs-asil.md','specs/006-enhanced-ai-software-assurance/owner-addendum-2026-10-17.md']
need = {'OPERATIONS.md': ['OBSERVE_ONLY','PILOT','ENFORCING','Oracle independence','owner'], 'normative-reconciliation-plan.md': ['NOT AVAILABLE','Copyright','reviewer']}
bad = []
for d in docs:
    t = Path(d).read_text(); bad += [f'{d}:{x}' for x in compliance_assertions(t)]
    bad += [f'{d}: missing {w}' for w in need.get(Path(d).name, []) if w not in t]
print('docs', len(docs), 'issues', bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
